notes.title: 22/02/2025 - More Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hello again~


Fixed a visual issue where Kazuya would glow indefinitely instead of glowing periodically when he has the Void Curse status effect.
Fixed an issue where the "IT'S TIME FOR A CHANGE" achievement was not unlocking reliably.
Fixed an issue where the "JUMP QUEEN" achievement sometimes required restarting the game to unlock.


Sorry for the inconvenience!
